scholarships.title: International Academic Merit Scholarship (Griffith University)
scholarships.funding_label: Tuition Fee Waiver (20% of tuition fees)

existing.description: Griffith University's International Academic Merit Scholarship gives eligible international students a 20% reduction in coursework tuition fees for the whole degree, with a lower entry GPA of 4.5 on a 7-point scale. No separate scholarship application is needed: Griffith assesses eligibility when the student applies to study and advises the outcome in the Letter of Offer under 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees'. It applies to most undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs, subject to a published exclusion list.
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand
Have a minimum GPA in previous studies of 4.5 on a 7-point scale or equivalent
Satisfy all academic and English language entry requirements for the chosen undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program
Be a full-time student starting in Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027

Not be enrolled in an excluded program (Bachelor of Medical Science, Bachelor of Dental Health Science, Doctor of Medicine, Master of Dentistry, Master of Speech Pathology, MBA, Graduate Diploma of Flight Management)
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries other than Australia or New Zealand, full-time students starting in Trimester 3 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027, with a minimum GPA of 4.5 on a 7-point scale (or equivalent), meeting the academic and English language entry requirements of their chosen coursework program.
benefits: 20% reduction of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees
Reduced deposit amount shown in the Letter of Offer reflecting the 20% scholarship
coverage: 20% of undergraduate or postgraduate coursework tuition fees for the duration of the program. Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered.
requirements: Must hold International Fee Paying student status; any change ends the scholarship
Must enrol full-time and make progress in studies meeting student visa requirements
Must pass all courses each trimester and progress to enrolment in the next
Must remain enrolled in the program named in the Letter of Offer
Internal transfer recipients must meet full-time enrolment requirements and have passed all prior courses to retain the scholarship

Excludes Higher Degree Research, non-award study, Study Abroad Program, Diploma programs, Masters Qualifying Program, MBA (5158), Bachelor of Medical Science, Bachelor of Dental Health Science, Master of Dentistry, Doctor of Medicine, Master of Speech Pathology, Graduate Diploma of Flight Management, Griffith English Language Institute programs, part-time-only programs and partner-delivered programs
If awarded a Griffith scholarship worth more than 20% of tuition, the higher-value scholarship applies instead
application_method: Apply to study an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program at Griffith University
Griffith assesses the application for scholarship eligibility
If successful, the award is advised in the Letter of Offer under 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees'
existing.selection_notes: No separate application and no competitive panel: the award is assessed on admission eligibility against the published GPA threshold. Applicants on packaged offers with a pathway provider have their scholarship eligibility assessed when final grades are provided to Griffith.
existing.best_fit: International applicants with a GPA of 4.5 or above on a 7-point scale entering a non-excluded Griffith coursework program who want an automatic tuition reduction rather than a competitive scholarship.
existing.notes: Awarded automatically on admission, not by a separate scholarship application. Covers only 20% of tuition, so the remaining tuition and all living costs must be funded by the student. The scholarship amount is non-refundable if the student withdraws or cancels.
existing.duration: Valid for the whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing eligibility requirements
existing.application_period: Rolling. Official start options: Trimester 3, 2025 or any trimester in 2026 or 2027. Students who defer commencement to 2028 or later are not eligible.
existing.deadline_display: No closing date - the scholarship is assessed automatically when you apply to study at Griffith
